STFC
STFC
STFC
The School of Physics & Astronomy holds a Science & Technologies Facilities Council Doctoral Training Account to provide PhD scholarships in nuclear physics, particle physics (experiment and theory), gravitational waves, astronomy and astrophysics.
Further information can be found at https://stfc.ukri.org/.
Open to Home, EU and International applicants.
Only open to PhD applicants.
Please refer to STFC webpage for full eligibility criteria.

Eligible programmes
Physics & Astronomy
Value
Full tuition fees and stipend at the UKRI rate for 3.5 years.
How to apply
Candidates interested in research in these areas should contact potential supervisors in the appropriate research group in the School of Physics & Astronomy: https://www.gla.ac.uk/postgraduate/research/physicsastronomy/
For more information contact: phas-pgradmissions@glasgow.ac.uk
